latestVersion.changelog:
Sixtyfour-skill 1.0.0 — initial release

- Provides company and people enrichment via the Sixtyfour AI API, focused on live web research (not static databases).
- Supports endpoints for lead and company enrichment, email and phone finding, lead scoring, natural language and filter-based search, and batch workflows.
- Returns structured, confidence-scored data with customizable fields.
- Offers both synchronous and asynchronous API support with sample payloads, response formats, and setup documentation.
- Targets users needing accurate, up-to-date people/company data for lead enrichment, research, and outreach.
